name: mirage
text: Understood. The engine's own bets and bids are unaffected and keep going. For hand bets I need to see one screen: Settings › Betting & Novig account (screenshot it and send it here). Meanwhile try this on the phone: tap Enable betting on that page. If it connects, the Bet buttons come back at once. If it says the key was revoked or refused, that confirms another device (the tablet, or the Send trading key to GitHub button) replaced the one trading key Novig allows, and I will give you the exact two taps to share one key between both devices.
